purpose: Close four reviewed exchange candidates after promotion through D-1000 BX28.

entries.notes: BX28 promotes Arkham Exchange as limited after first-party centralized and decentralized trading review. Independent exchange tracking currently reports no tracked pairs or volume, so active status is not asserted.

BX28 promotes YoBit after current first-party market review and independent current spot-market and non-zero-volume verification. Confidence remains medium because ownership and jurisdiction are opaque and current quality warnings remain material.
BX28 promotes Hodl Hodl after current first-party non-custodial peer-to-peer Bitcoin marketplace and active API review.
BX28 promotes Paxful as dead with first-party evidence for a 2025-10-01 wind-down announcement and 2025-11-01 effective end of trading and deposits, leaving withdrawals only.
